title: Restrict redirect targets to trusted destinations
summary: Redirects whose destination comes from request data must be limited to known paths or hosts so the application cannot be used to send users to attacker-controlled sites.
review_checks: Find redirect calls that take next, return, url, or similar parameters.
Check handling of absolute URLs, protocol-relative URLs (//host), and encoded variants.
safe_tests: Pass an external absolute URL and a protocol-relative URL to the redirect parameter on a local instance and confirm the redirect stays on the application.
remediation: Redirect only to relative paths validated against an allowlist, or map short keys to destinations server-side.
Reject values that parse to a different host or scheme.
